identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.19: optional custom peds (Config.CustomPeds, off by default): admins give a character any ped model with /setped, and the clothing store and barber open the same editor with only that ped's own pieces. Also: on VORP, two characters could share one selection slot (one hidden, the other selected); every character now gets its own slot.

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.123: the fuel arm clips end with the hose.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.92: more than one gym. Config.Gyms lists them (Strawberry comes ready, with its blip and record board); add one anywhere station by station, its type and the spot the player stands on, and the script lays its equipment out. Config.Blip moved into each gym's entry.
